ValidationRule.description: Cannot change Order Status to 'Canceled' without completing all fields in uLab Internal Cancelation section
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name ="Customer Order", ISPICKVAL(Order_Status__c, "Cancelled"), ISCHANGED(Order_Status__c), OR(ISBLANK( Order_Cancellation_Date__c ), ISBLANK( Order_Cancellation_Comments__c), ISBLANK( Cancellation_Reason__c ), ISBLANK( TEXT( Cancelation_Requested_By__c )), ISBLANK( TEXT(Current_MFG__c ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must complete all fields in the 'uLab Internal Cancellation' section below before saving this order as 'Cancelled'.
